next.reason: 1985: 'Division by zero always terminates the arithmetic operation and always causes a size error condition.' 2023: the size error condition exists 'if the divisor in a divide operation or in a DIVIDE statement is zero' (§2023:14.7.5 GR2); with the phrase the resultants 'remain unchanged from the values they had at the start of the execution of the arithmetic statement' (§2023:14.7.5, catalog L2.1); §2023:14.7.7 GR4 'If the size error condition is raised during the initial evaluation, none of the resultant data items are changed'. The no-phrase EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE (L3.2) revises 1985 GR3, not this rule.
